title: latency-confidence-gating: staged-variant-escalation-and-network-integrity-quarantine
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem statement: We need an automated, low-false-positive mechanism to decide region selection at request time using production latency telemetry (p50/p95) and network quality signals. Existing heuristics trigger aggressive cross-region failovers during transient spikes and create oscillation; they also lack a way to safely escalate to lower-cost or lower-capacity model variants without impacting tail latency for high-priority customers.

Proposal summary: Implement a latency confidence gating controller that (a) computes rolling bootstrap-derived confidence intervals for p50 and p95 per POP, (b) fuses latency quantiles with network integrity signals (packet loss, rtt jitter, TCP retransmits) into a single health score, (c) introduces a quarantine window for low-confidence anomalies to avoid immediate mass failover, and (d) supports staged variant escalation: first soft-degrade to same-model quantized variant, then to lower-parameter variant only when confidence crosses critical thresholds. Include VIP bypass rules and a simulation mode (offline and shadow) before any global rollout.

Goals:
- Reduce noisy region failovers and oscillation by 60% in first 30 days after rollout.
- Keep p95 for premium routes within SLO 95% of the time while reducing cost via variant escalation where safe.
- Provide transparency (dashboard + audit log) for quarantine events and variant escalations per request.

Key behavioral rules:
- Confidence windows: maintain two parallel windows: short (2m EWMA + bootstrap samples from last 2 minutes) for rapid detection and long (30m sliding) for stabilization. Use overlap test between windows to decide quarantine.
- Quarantine: when short-window health score indicates severe degradation but long-window is healthy or low-confidence, place POP into quarantine for a configurable cooldown (default 5m) and route a sampled percentage (5%) of traffic as canary to validate.
- Staged variant escalation: step 0 (fallback policy) continue to prefer same-architecture variants; step 1 soft-degrade -> quantized variant with KV-cache preserved; step 2 escalate -> smaller parameter model only if both p95 degraded and packet loss elevated beyond thresholds for the long window.
- VIP bypass: token-granularity overrides to avoid variant escalation for configured tokens/projects; route through reserved capacity or span additional POPs.

Rollout plan: local simulation using 14-day historical telemetry; shadow routing with 1% sampled real traffic for 3 days; phased regional rollout by traffic volume (APAC -> EMEA -> NAM) with abort thresholds (error rate increase > 0.3% absolute OR p95 increase > 15% for 10m).

Observability and telemetry: add metrics: pop_health_score, pop_confidence_interval_p95_lower, pop_confidence_interval_p95_upper, quarantine_count, staged_escalation_count, canary_validation_success_rate. Capture per-request tags: decision_reason, confidence_snapshot, active_variant. Store audit events to long-term retention for incident debugging.
acceptance_criteria: Controller exposes REST interface returning health scores and confidence intervals for a given POP
Can simulate gating decisions offline using 14-day telemetry and produce a decision log identical to online decisions in simulation mode
Shadow mode (1%) runs for at least 72 hours with no customer-impacting escalations
Quarantine events emit audit logs with decision_reason and confidence_snapshot
Staged variant escalation has opt-out per-token and respects VIP bypass list
Unit + integration tests cover EWMA/bootstrapped CI computation and tie-breaker logic between short/long windows
notes_and_decisions: 2026-03-04: Chose bootstrap sampling over parametric CI because latency distributions are heavy-tailed and non-Gaussian in many POPs
2026-03-05: Decided to preserve KV cache when switching to quantized variant to avoid repeated cold-prefix latency spikes
2026-03-06: Trade-off: longer quarantine reduces flapping but delays remediation for true outages; default quarantine 5m strikes pragmatic balance per ops feedback
2026-03-08: Agreed on two-window overlap test; short window detects spikes, long window reduces false positives from sampling noise
2026-03-09: Reviewer (SRE lead) recommended canary sample size 5% and explicit abort thresholds for rollout; added to rollout plan
implementation_steps: Instrument per-POP rolling latency histograms exported to telemetry pipeline with 1s granularity
Implement bootstrapped CI worker that reads N samples from histogram stream and outputs p50/p95 CI every 10s
Create fusion function combining normalized quantile deviations with packet-loss and jitter into unified health score
Implement quarantine controller with short/long window logic and sampled canary routing
Add variant registry hooks to orchestrator to perform staged escalation with cache-preserving switches
Build console view: per-POP health, confidence bands, quarantine timeline and canary validation results
Write chaos tests (region packet-loss, rtt spike, partial POP outage) and run against canary region
risks_and_mitigations: False positive quarantines could route traffic away from healthy POPs: mitigate with overlap test + canary validation + gradual rollout
Bootstrap CI compute overhead: mitigate by sampling histograms and running CI workers per region group rather than per POP at first
KV-cache mismatch during variant switch: preserve cache where feasible and add incremental rebuild telemetry
VIP bypass complexity could create accounting gaps: require audit log entry for every bypass and count separately in cost dashboards
testing_plan: Offline replay against 14 days of telemetry and compare baseline decisions to controller decisions
Shadow routing with 1% traffic for 72 hours, verify no escalations triggered for non-VIP routes
Chaos engineering: induce 10% packet loss in a canary POP and observe quarantine + canary validation behavior
Load tests for CI worker scale: simulate histograms for 200 POPs and validate CPU/memory footprint
E2E regression tests ensuring fallback rollback within 30s when canary failure criteria met
